GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, worked home well but never a threat # back/home ok
jumped out fine. Drifted Back Settled Down Inside 9th 7 Lengths @ 800m. Hooked Out well off fence Straightening Up . Ridden Along all Clear 300m. Just Held Ground final 200m # Never Likely

Slow away. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inisde (6L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Chasing Two Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Held pu Two Wide @ 250m & held ground in last 100m. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly during the middle stages. Near the 800m, checked from heels. Held up during the early part of the straight before being further steadied and directed inwards to obtain clear running near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, Held Up home turn then Hooked Out 3 Wide at the 350m, Made Some Ground down the outside in Straight # slow out/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until near the 350m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Just a Bit Slow Out , Settled Down Inside 8th 6 Lengths @ 950m. off rail in Straight and gradually finished off ok , Just missed 4th place . $3.30 winner led # finish best part
Jumped only fairly missing start 1 length and Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Made Ground along fence in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Momentarily held up on heels rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat rail 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly during the middle stages. Near the 200m shifted inwards and bumped another runner before being bumped again by that runner, which shifted out shortly afterwards.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed out Five Wide @ 400m & pushed along Six Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & worked home steadily in last 200m. # Sound for further.
Jumped Ok eased back 5l off, improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, took over 200m and drew clear # had run/too good
jumped fair went back to 2nd last 6len 600m 3rd last Hooked Out 200m got home hard # back/home hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 200m was inclined to lay in and made contact with another runner before being corrected.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped only fairly. Two Wide Off Mid-Field very keen early 8 Lengths @ 800m. fanned widest Straightening Up all Clear . Just Inside winner 200m. couldn't quicken as required (vetted - no abnormalities) # keen/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: For some distance approaching and passing the 800m, got its head up and raced ungenerously when being steadied from heels. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
